subject: SDLC integrity evidence: CI controls, secrets rotation & change timeline
messages:
From: Lena Morales <lena@acmeassessors.com>
To: michael_grant@redwoodinference.com
Cc: irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 24 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SDLC artifacts for SIG/CAIQ review

Hi Michael,

We are starting the SIG/CAIQ intake for Acme Financial and need a compact set of artifacts demonstrating your secure SDLC controls for code review, CI/CD gating, secrets handling, and change management.

Primary asks:
- Branch protection and PR gating policies (examples).
- Evidence of PR code review enforcement and reviewer assignment rules.
- CI pipeline description showing how secrets are provisioned (ephemeral tokens, KMS/HSM usage).
- A recent change chronology for an emergency rollback that includes approval trail and blameless postmortem link.
- Any redacted logs or runbook snippets that show gating and deploy verification.

We don't need full raw logs — redacted extracts and links to canonical artifacts are fine. Could you confirm the items you can provide and estimated delivery? We have a tight window for Acme's assessment: target intake deadline is 2025-08-30.

Thanks,
Lena Morales
Principal Assessor
Acme Security Assessment

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Morales <lena@acmeassessors.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 24 Aug 2025 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC artifacts for SIG/CAIQ review

Hi Lena — thanks for the note and the deadline.

Quick confirmation: we can provide a focused bundle covering all bullets you listed. High-level plan and ETA:
- Branch protection & PR gating policy: PDF + a recent repo-level policy snapshot (same day).
- Code review enforcement: policy doc + a redacted PR audit showing reviewer assignments and merge blocks (by 2025-08-26).
- CI secrets: runbook snippet + redacted rotation log showing KMS integration and short-lived token issuance (by 2025-08-26).
- Change chronology: we can provide the change-gate chronology and the postmortem link for the June emergency rollback (redacted where needed) — deliverable 2025-08-26.

Couple of quick clarifying Qs before we assemble:
1) For the PR audit, do you need raw GitHub audit events or is a redacted CSV with PR IDs, reviewers, and timestamps sufficient?
2) For the change chronology, Acme sometimes asks for signed approvals in our ticketing system — is a link to the ticket plus a PDF export OK, or do you require exported SSO logs?

I'll assemble the initial bundle and share via a locked Drive folder and include the redaction index. Irene (cc) will help pull the CI rotation bits.

Best,

Michael Grant
Head of Security & Compliance (acting)
Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-0179

From: Lena Morales <lena@acmeassessors.com>
To: michael_grant@redwoodinference.com
Cc: irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 25 Aug 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC artifacts for SIG/CAIQ review

Thanks Michael — redacted artifacts will be fine. A couple of preferences to speed review: 
- For the PR audit: redacted CSV is fine, but we need PR IDs and a column that shows 'merge_blocked_by_policy' true/false, plus reviewer role (e.g., 'team_reviewer', 'security_reviewer').
- For CI secrets: a short snippet demonstrating how CI obtains ephemeral credentials (e.g., step-by-step for a single job) is ideal. If you can include code or config pointers (file paths) in the runbook snippet, that helps.
- For the change chronology: the ticket link plus exported PDF of approvals is preferred. If you include a short timeline narrative (who approved what and when) that will shorten assessor back-and-forth.

One more ask: any evidence that demonstrates enforcement (alerts, blocked merges, or failed runs due to missing approvals) is valuable. Even a single redacted example of a blocked merge / failed pipeline will do.

Lena

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Morales <lena@acmeassessors.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 26 Aug 2025 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC artifacts for SIG/CAIQ review — bundle delivered

Hi Lena — attaching a compact bundle and notes below. Per our earlier exchange, artifacts are redacted and scoped to the assessment questions. Folder and files attached; links at the bottom.

Attachments included (redacted where appropriate):
- branch-protection-policy-2025-07.pdf — policy summary, required checks, required reviewer counts, and protected-branch exceptions list.
- ci-runbook-snippet.txt — excerpt showing CI job steps for deploy pipelines, token exchange with KMS, and the ephemeral credential handoff (short-lived role assumption).
- secrets-rotation-redacted.csv — sample rotation records (timestamps, key alias, rotated-by-service) with PII removed.
- change-gate-chronology-2025-06.log — exported timeline for the June emergency rollback (ticket IDs redacted), includes approver principals, timestamps, and rollback verification steps.

Highlights / answers to your clarifying Qs:
- PR audit: provided as a redacted CSV in the Drive folder named 'pr-audit-redacted.csv' — columns: pr_id, repo, author_team, reviewer_role, merged_at, merge_blocked_by_policy. This satisfies the 'blocked merges' requirement; one sample PR shows merge_blocked_by_policy=true with the attached reviewer notes.
- Change approvals: we included the ticket PDF export (redacted) and a one-paragraph timeline in the log file clarifying who approved the emergency change. SSO logs are available on request under tighter controls — let us know if Acme needs them.
- CI secrets: ci-runbook-snippet.txt shows step-level commands that call our secrets-proxy which mints ephemeral credentials from AWS KMS/STS; we note TTLs are short (default 15 minutes) and tokens are scoped per-job.

If you want the raw GitHub audit events or the unredacted ticket exports for an on-site assessor review, we can arrange a read-only session. For intake purposes, the Drive folder should be enough to complete the SIG/CAIQ questionnaire.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_example_sdlc_evidence
HubSpot intake: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ACME-12345

Attachments: branch-protection-policy-2025-07.pdf; ci-runbook-snippet.txt; secrets-rotation-redacted.csv; change-gate-chronology-2025-06.log

Best regards,
Michael Grant
Head of Security & Compliance (acting)
Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwoodinference.com
